meta.name: XITE 90s Throwback
meta.description:
Throwback to the days of flannel shirts, hella bling, boy bands/girl groups and genre bending crossovers. From Grunge, Britpop, Dance Pop, the “golden era” of R&B, Hip-Hop and everything in between – it’s all that and a 90s Throwback.

Shows: 90s 4 Ever, Back 2 The 90s, Nighttime 90s, All Night 90s
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, iptv-org
